steps.title: Save the session
steps.body: File > Save Session writes the whole scene, its layers and settings, to a .jhv file that opens it again later.

steps.title: Your own starting scene
steps.body: File > Set Current Session as Default opens this scene at every start, ahead of the last session. File > Clear Default Session undoes it.

steps.title: Share Scene
steps.body: File > Share Scene saves the scene for someone else: your home folder is written as ~, and local files outside the cache are listed first.

steps.title: Take the data too
steps.body: File > Export Session with Data saves the session plus a .data.zip of its local files, to open on another computer.

steps.title: Copy Provenance
steps.body: File > Copy Provenance puts the program, its build and each layer's data source on the clipboard, for a caption or a methods section.

steps.title: Copy Frame
steps.body: Edit > Copy Frame puts the canvas picture on the clipboard, as an 8-bit screenshot.

steps.title: Send to Python
steps.body: Layers > Send to Python writes the active layer's FITS files as double-precision science FITS, plus a manifest and a sunpy snippet.

steps.title: SAMP
steps.body: SAMP sends a message to other astronomy tools that speak SAMP, the Virtual Observatory's messaging protocol.
